# default

### C4 Level 1 - System Context

Shows who interacts with dotnet-observability-lab and keeps .NET Aspire explicit as development tooling rather than part of the functional message path.

```mermaid
---
title: "C4 Level 1 - System Context"
---
graph LR
  ApiClient@{ icon: "fa:user", shape: rounded, label: "API client" }
  Developer@{ icon: "fa:user", shape: rounded, label: "Developer" }
  Lab@{ shape: rectangle, label: "dotnet-observability-lab" }
  Aspire@{ shape: rectangle, label: "Aspire development environment" }
  ApiClient -. "`Exercises the lab through HTTP`" .-> Lab
  Developer -. "`Develops and studies the reference 
implementation`" .-> Lab
  Developer -. "`Runs and inspects the local environment`" .-> Aspire
  Lab -. "`[...]`" .-> Aspire
  Aspire -. "`[...]`" .-> Lab
```

### C4 Level 3 - Ingestion.Api

Shows the HTTP write boundary, idempotency, Redis optimization and the atomic PostgreSQL Outbox write.

```mermaid
---
title: "C4 Level 3 - Ingestion.Api"
---
graph LR
  ApiClient@{ icon: "fa:user", shape: rounded, label: "API client" }
  LabIngestionApiValuesEndpoint@{ shape: rectangle, label: "HTTP ingestion endpoint" }
  LabIngestionApiIngestionUseCase@{ shape: rectangle, label: "Idempotent ingestion use case" }
  LabIngestionApiIngestionPersistence@{ shape: rectangle, label: "EF Core transactional persistence" }
  LabRedis@{ shape: cylinder, label: "Redis" }
  LabPostgresql@{ shape: cylinder, label: "PostgreSQL" }
  ApiClient -. "`POST /values with Idempotency-Key`" .-> LabIngestionApiValuesEndpoint
  LabIngestionApiValuesEndpoint -. "`Delegates the validated request`" .-> LabIngestionApiIngestionUseCase
  LabIngestionApiIngestionUseCase -. "`Reads original receipt or commits value 
and Outbox`" .-> LabIngestionApiIngestionPersistence
  LabIngestionApiIngestionPersistence -. "`Uses ingestion_db and its unique key 
constraint`" .-> LabPostgresql
  LabIngestionApiIngestionUseCase -. "`Optionally caches committed receipts`" .-> LabRedis
```

### C4 Level 3 - Ingestion.Outbox.Worker

Dedicated PostgreSQL Outbox claiming and confirmed RabbitMQ publication, independent of Ingestion.Api.

```mermaid
---
title: "C4 Level 3 - Ingestion.Outbox.Worker"
---
graph LR
  LabIngestionOutboxWorkerOutboxPoller@{ shape: rectangle, label: "Outbox poller" }
  LabIngestionOutboxWorkerRabbitPublisher@{ shape: rectangle, label: "RabbitMQ publisher adapter" }
  LabPostgresql@{ shape: cylinder, label: "PostgreSQL" }
  LabRabbitmq@{ shape: horizontal-cylinder, label: "RabbitMQ" }
  LabIngestionOutboxWorkerOutboxPoller -. "`Passes versioned event and stable 
message ID`" .-> LabIngestionOutboxWorkerRabbitPublisher
  LabIngestionOutboxWorkerOutboxPoller -. "`Claims pending Outbox records and 
commits confirmed publication`" .-> LabPostgresql
  LabIngestionOutboxWorkerRabbitPublisher -. "`Mandatory persistent publish with broker 
confirmation`" .-> LabRabbitmq
```

### C4 Level 3 - Consolidation.Api

Independent HTTP read endpoint and read-only PostgreSQL query; no Ingestion.Api or RabbitMQ dependency.

```mermaid
---
title: "C4 Level 3 - Consolidation.Api"
---
graph LR
  ApiClient@{ icon: "fa:user", shape: rounded, label: "API client" }
  LabConsolidationApiConsolidatedEndpoint@{ shape: rectangle, label: "GET /consolidated" }
  LabConsolidationApiConsolidatedQuery@{ shape: rectangle, label: "Consolidated read query" }
  LabPostgresql@{ shape: cylinder, label: "PostgreSQL" }
  ApiClient -. "`GET /consolidated`" .-> LabConsolidationApiConsolidatedEndpoint
  LabConsolidationApiConsolidatedEndpoint -. "`Requests last durable snapshot`" .-> LabConsolidationApiConsolidatedQuery
  LabConsolidationApiConsolidatedQuery -. "`Reads consolidation_db without ingestion 
or broker dependency`" .-> LabPostgresql
```

### C4 Level 3 - Consolidation.Worker

Manual RabbitMQ acknowledgements after atomic PostgreSQL Inbox and read-model commit; no Redis consumer lookup.

```mermaid
---
title: "C4 Level 3 - Consolidation.Worker"
---
graph LR
  LabRabbitmq@{ shape: horizontal-cylinder, label: "RabbitMQ" }
  LabConsolidationWorkerRabbitConsumer@{ shape: rectangle, label: "RabbitMQ consumer adapter" }
  LabConsolidationWorkerInboxProcessor@{ shape: rectangle, label: "Transactional Inbox processor" }
  LabConsolidationWorkerConsolidationStore@{ shape: rectangle, label: "Consolidation persistence" }
  LabPostgresql@{ shape: cylinder, label: "PostgreSQL" }
  LabRabbitmq -. "`Delivers ValueReceived.v1`" .-> LabConsolidationWorkerRabbitConsumer
  LabConsolidationWorkerRabbitConsumer -. "`Passes validated neutral event`" .-> LabConsolidationWorkerInboxProcessor
  LabConsolidationWorkerInboxProcessor -. "`Claims Inbox and updates aggregate`" .-> LabConsolidationWorkerConsolidationStore
  LabConsolidationWorkerConsolidationStore -. "`Commits Inbox and total to 
consolidation_db`" .-> LabPostgresql
```

### ValueReceived.v1 - accepted write to independent consolidated read

One successful request, durable Outbox handoff and separate read request. Aspire receives OTLP telemetry only; it is not a business hop.

```mermaid
---
title: "ValueReceived.v1 - accepted write to independent consolidated read"
---
graph LR
  ApiClient@{ icon: "fa:user", shape: rounded, label: "API client" }
  LabIngestionApi@{ shape: rounded, label: "Ingestion.Api" }
  LabRedis@{ shape: cylinder, label: "Redis" }
  LabIngestionOutboxWorker@{ shape: rectangle, label: "Ingestion.Outbox.Worker" }
  LabPostgresql@{ shape: cylinder, label: "PostgreSQL" }
  LabRabbitmq@{ shape: horizontal-cylinder, label: "RabbitMQ" }
  LabConsolidationWorker@{ shape: rectangle, label: "Consolidation.Worker" }
  LabConsolidationApi@{ shape: rounded, label: "Consolidation.Api" }
  ApiClient -. "`POST /values (new Idempotency-Key)`" .-> LabIngestionApi
  LabIngestionApi -. "`Best-effort receipt cache lookup`" .-> LabRedis
  LabIngestionApi -. "`Commit value + Outbox in ingestion_db`" .-> LabPostgresql
  LabIngestionApi -. "`HTTP 201 + value receipt`" .-> ApiClient
  LabIngestionOutboxWorker -. "`Claim pending Outbox (ingestion_db)`" .-> LabPostgresql
  LabIngestionOutboxWorker -. "`Confirm persistent ValueReceived.v1 
publish`" .-> LabRabbitmq
  LabIngestionOutboxWorker -. "`Mark Outbox published after broker 
confirmation`" .-> LabPostgresql
  LabRabbitmq -. "`Deliver event (at least once)`" .-> LabConsolidationWorker
  LabConsolidationWorker -. "`Commit Inbox + total in consolidation_db`" .-> LabPostgresql
  LabConsolidationWorker -. "`Acknowledge only after durable commit`" .-> LabRabbitmq
  ApiClient -. "`GET /consolidated (separate HTTP 
request)`" .-> LabConsolidationApi
  LabConsolidationApi -. "`Read latest total from consolidation_db`" .-> LabPostgresql
  LabConsolidationApi -. "`HTTP 200 + durable snapshot`" .-> ApiClient
```

### C4 Level 2 - Containers

Shows independent APIs and active PostgreSQL, ingestion Redis and RabbitMQ business relationships; provisioned-only Redis references are not runtime edges. Separate OTLP exports end at the Aspire Dashboard, which does not route business traffic.

  LabIngestionOutboxWorker -. "`Exports Outbox producer spans and

  AspireAppHostDashboard -. "`Orchestrates local process`" .-> LabConsolidationWorker
